title: The Language of Bargaining: Linguistic Effects in LLM Negotiations

bias_targets.methodology: Simulating multi-agent negotiation games (Ultimatum, Buy-Sell, Resource Exchange) across different language framings (English, Hindi, Punjabi, Gujarati, Marwadi) to compare objective outcomes like agreement rates, payoffs, and role advantages based solely on the interaction language.

Analyzing role-based asymmetries (e.g., seller vs. buyer advantage) in multi-turn LLM negotiations to detect the activation of culturally encoded stereotypes (such as the 'Marwadi trader' stereotype or English 'Western consumer' norms) triggered by linguistic framing.
